title: melicope rotundifolia
intro: Melicope rotundifolia, commonly known as the Round-Leaf Melicope or Hawaiian Neem, is a flowering plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including its potential health benefits such as treating digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Melicope rotundifolia include flavonoids, limonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
